extraction_notes: Sewing thread of man-made (synthetic) filament — heading 5401 distinguishes sewing thread (put up for retail or otherwise prepared) from filament yarn of 5402.
Sewing thread of artificial (cellulosic) filament — viscose/acetate-class threads used in textile assembly.
Aramid high-tenacity filament yarn (Kevlar/Nomex class) — para-aramid used in body armour, ropes, brake linings; meta-aramid in flame-resistant apparel. Subheading 5402.11 specifically aramids.
Nylon tyre yarn — high-tenacity nylon 6 or nylon 66 yarn used as reinforcing cord in tyre carcasses; classic Indian sub-category at 8-digit.
Nylon 66 filament yarn meeting IS 13464 (Indian Standard for industrial nylon yarn) — India-specific 8-digit carve-out.
Residual basket for high-tenacity nylon/polyamide yarn not falling in 5402.19.10/.20.
Terylene/dacron — trade names for high-tenacity polyester (PET) filament yarn; commonly used in tyre cord and industrial seat-belt webbing.
Residual basket for high-tenacity polyester filament yarn not the terylene/dacron variant.
Textured nylon yarn, fine count (single yarn <=50 tex) — used in fine hosiery, lingerie and lightweight knit goods.
Textured nylon yarn, coarser count (single yarn >50 tex) — used in heavier apparel and outerwear fabrics.
Textured polyester filament yarn (PTY/DTY) — workhorse of India's synthetic apparel weaving and knitting industries.
Textured polypropylene yarn — bulked PP filament typical for carpets and upholstery applications.
Other textured filament yarn — Indian sub-line for PP filament yarn not specifically textured (5402.34) or POY/single (5402.48).
Acrylic filament yarn (rare — most acrylic comes as staple Ch.55) classified under textured-yarn basket 5402.39.
Residual basket for textured synthetic filament yarns not separately enumerated.
Elastomeric filament yarn (e.g. spandex/Lycra polyurethane class) — single, untwisted/low-twist. Chapter Note 1(c) defines 'elastomeric'.
Non-textured single nylon filament yarn, low twist (<=50 tpm), not high-tenacity — flat yarn used in lightweight wovens.
Partially Oriented Yarn (POY) — feedstock polyester filament for draw-texturing into DTY; major Indian intermediate yarn category.
Flat polyester filament yarn (FDY/SDY) — fully drawn, not POY, used directly in weaving lining and shirting fabrics.
Non-textured single PP filament yarn, low twist — flat polypropylene used in synthetic upholstery and industrial wovens.
Residual basket — other single synthetic filament yarns, untwisted/low-twist (<=50 tpm), not separately enumerated.
Nylon single filament yarn with twist >50 tpm — crepe-construction or specialty wovens.
Anti-static polyester filament — typically carbon-doped or surface-treated for ESD-protective fabrics in cleanrooms/electronics.
Residual polyester single filament yarn with twist >50 tpm, not anti-static.
Residual basket for other single synthetic filament yarns with twist >50 tpm.
Multiple (folded/plied) or cabled nylon filament yarn — two or more singles twisted together for added strength.
Multiple folded or cabled polyester filament yarn — plied PFY for sewing, weaving heavy fabrics.
Multiple folded or cabled polypropylene filament yarn — plied PP yarn for industrial wovens and woven carpets.
Polyvinyl acetate filament yarn — rare specialty fibre, sometimes used as water-soluble support yarn.
Polyvinyl chloride filament yarn (PVC/chlorofibre) — inherently flame-resistant; used in protective wovens.
Indian sub-category — PP filament yarn redundantly placed under 5402.69 (Other multiple/cabled) for residual classification.
Acrylic filament yarn in multiple/folded form — Indian sub-category despite acrylic typically being staple fibre.
PTFE (Teflon) filament yarn — chemically inert, used in pump gland packing, filter fabrics for hot/corrosive gases.
Ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) filament yarn — Dyneema/Spectra class, conforming to ASTM F2848; ballistic body armour, cut-resistant gloves.
Residual basket for other multiple/cabled synthetic filament yarns not separately enumerated.
Viscose rayon high-tenacity tyre yarn at 1,233 decitex — Indian count-specific 8-digit, classical bias-ply tyre reinforcement.
Viscose rayon high-tenacity tyre yarn at 1,833 decitex — coarser count for heavy-duty tyre carcass.
Residual viscose rayon high-tenacity yarn at counts other than 1,233 or 1,833 decitex.
Viscose rayon single filament yarn, low twist (<=120 tpm) — note twist threshold differs from synthetic (50 tpm) for artificial filaments.
Viscose rayon single yarn, high twist (>120 tpm) — typically destined for crepe-construction wovens.
Cellulose acetate single filament yarn — silky lustrous artificial filament typical for lining and lightweight apparel.
Cuprammonium rayon (Bemberg) — premium cellulosic filament regenerated through cuprammonium hydroxide; very fine drape.
Residual basket for other artificial single filament yarns (e.g. lyocell, modal) not separately enumerated.
Viscose rayon multiple/folded yarn, ultrafine count up to 67 decitex.
Viscose rayon multiple/folded yarn at 83 decitex — Indian count-specific 8-digit.
Viscose rayon at 111 decitex, bright lustre (no delusterant). India distinguishes bright vs dull rayon at 8-digit.
Viscose rayon at 111 decitex, dull (delustered with TiO2 for matte finish).
Viscose rayon at 133 decitex, bright lustre.
Viscose rayon at 133 decitex, dull (TiO2-delustered).
Viscose rayon at 167 decitex, bright lustre.
Viscose rayon at 167 decitex, dull.
Residual viscose rayon multiple/folded yarn at counts other than the enumerated decitex bands.
Acetate rayon multiple/folded filament yarn at 83 decitex — Indian count-specific 8-digit.
Acetate rayon filament yarn at 111 decitex.
Acetate rayon filament yarn at 133 decitex.
Acetate rayon filament yarn at 167 decitex.
Acetate rayon filament yarn at 333 decitex — coarser specialty count.
Residual basket for acetate rayon at counts other than enumerated.
Cuprammonium (Bemberg) filament yarn at ultrafine 33 decitex — premium silky lining yarn.
Cuprammonium filament yarn at 44 decitex.
Cuprammonium filament yarn at 67 decitex.
Cuprammonium filament yarn at 83 decitex.
Cuprammonium filament yarn at 89 decitex.
Residual cuprammonium filament yarn within sub-group 5403.49.1x.
Residual other artificial filament multiple/folded yarns not separately enumerated (note: input description repeats 'Cuprammonium ---- Other' but heading basket is broader).
Synthetic monofilament — elastomeric (e.g. polyurethane spandex monofilament). Heading 5404 requires >=67 decitex AND cross-section <=1mm (else moves to Ch.39).
Polypropylene synthetic monofilament — fishing-net twine, filter-cloth bristles, woven sack reinforcement.
Catgut imitation of synthetic yarn (non-sterile) — synthetic monofilament substitute for animal-gut strings; sterile sutures excluded (Ch.30).
Strip of synthetic fibre material (e.g. PP tape) — apparent width <=5mm; basis of woven-sack industry. >5mm wide flips to Ch.39 sheet.
Residual other synthetic monofilament — polyester monofilament, nylon monofilament for industrial use.
Catgut imitation in the residual 5404.90 strip-and-other basket — same vocational use (strings) but classification format differs.
Strip of synthetic fibre materials (5404.90 basket) — same as 5404.19.20 economically; Indian tariff retains parallel sub-line.
Residual basket for other synthetic strip and the like not enumerated above.
Artificial (cellulosic) monofilament >=67 dtex and <=1mm cross-section; or strip <=5mm width (e.g. cellulosic artificial straw for hatmaking).
Synthetic filament yarn put up for retail sale (distinguishes from 5402 which excludes retail packaging).
Artificial filament yarn put up for retail sale (parallels 5406.00.10 for the cellulosic side).
Parachute fabric — high-tenacity nylon ripstop, unbleached. Heading 5407.10 = woven fabrics from HT yarn of nylon/polyamide or polyester.
Tent fabric (unbleached) — heavy industrial nylon/polyester weave, before make-up. Made-up tents themselves go to Ch.63.
Nylon furnishing fabric (unbleached) — woven from high-tenacity nylon filament for upholstery/drape.
Umbrella cloth panel fabric (unbleached) — woven from nylon HT yarn, pre-finished panel cuts.
Other nylon/polyamide filament fabric (unbleached) — residual in 5407.10 unbleached sub-block.
Polyester suitings (unbleached) — premium tailoring fabric woven from high-tenacity polyester filament.
Other polyester fabrics (unbleached) — residual non-suiting polyester wovens within 5407.10 unbleached.
Parachute fabric, bleached — peroxide-bleached HT nylon for white parachute applications.
Tent fabric, bleached — white-base tent canvas equivalent of synthetic origin.
Nylon furnishing fabric, bleached — base for printed/dyed upholstery in subsequent finishing.
Umbrella cloth panel fabric, bleached — white-base umbrella panels for downstream colouring.
Other nylon/polyamide filament-yarn fabric, bleached — residual within 5407.10 bleached sub-block.
Polyester suitings, bleached — base white fabric for downstream dyeing into solid-colour suits.
Other bleached residual under 5407.10 bleached block — synthetic filament wovens not separately enumerated.
Parachute fabric, dyed — colour-impregnated HT nylon for camo/visibility variants.
Tent fabric, dyed — solid-colour tent canvas, e.g. olive military shade.
Nylon furnishing fabric, dyed — solid-colour upholstery cloth.
Umbrella cloth panel fabric, dyed — coloured panels for umbrella manufacture.
Other nylon/polyamide filament fabric, dyed — residual within 5407.10 dyed sub-block.
Polyester suitings, dyed — finished solid-colour suiting fabric ready for tailoring.
Other dyed residual in 5407.10 — synthetic filament wovens not separately enumerated.
Parachute fabric, printed — patterned (e.g. camouflage print) HT nylon parachute cloth.
Tent fabric, printed — patterned tent cloth, e.g. for retail camping with graphic print.
Nylon furnishing fabric, printed — patterned upholstery/drape cloth.
Umbrella cloth panel fabric, printed — patterned umbrella panels.
Other nylon/polyamide filament fabric, printed — residual within 5407.10 printed sub-block.
Polyester suitings, printed — patterned suiting fabric (e.g. window-pane checks via print).
Other printed residual within 5407.10 — synthetic filament wovens not enumerated above.
